title: SETTINGS: AN EXPERIMENTAL MENU WITH THE FIRST FOUR SWITCHES
why: His order (round 3, 2.R4 b): a separate menu, opened from Settings, that switches the newer features on and off. Settings has one new row, experimental, that opens a page in the same layout with an on/off row per feature and a back button; esc and B back out of the page before they close Settings. Every switch starts on, so with nothing touched the game is exactly as before. A switch is read once when the raid starts and held for the raid, and in a party the host switches rule for both windows. This first build brings the menu and four switches: run goals, golden enemy, strongholds and power-ups. The other features follow in small builds.
now: Settings has an experimental page with on/off rows for run goals, golden enemy, strongholds and power-ups.
